description: This file defines data structures and methods related to samples, streams, and metrics used in Prometheus monitoring, including JSON serialization/deserialization, equality checks, and string representations.

classes.name: Sample
classes.description: Represents a metric sample with optional histogram, timestamp, and metric data.

classes.name: Samples
classes.description: A sortable slice of Sample pointers.

classes.name: SampleStream
classes.description: A stream of samples and histograms associated with a metric.

classes.name: Scalar
classes.description: A scalar value evaluated at a specific timestamp.

classes.name: String
classes.description: A string value evaluated at a specific timestamp.

classes.name: Vector
classes.description: An alias for a slice of Samples where all have the same timestamp.

classes.name: Matrix
classes.description: A list of SampleStreams representing time series data.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Compares two samples or sets of samples for equality.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the sample or vector.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into the object.

methods.name: Len
methods.description: Returns the length of the slice or collection.

methods.name: Swap
methods.description: Swaps two elements in a slice.
